events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! What's your favourite iconic moment or lyric from the man himself?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal solo album 'Imagine' was released in the UK on October 8, 1971.

angles.name: Imagine the impact
angles.copy: More than five decades on, John Lennon's 'Imagine' album still resonates. Which track from this iconic record means the most to you?

events.title: First iPod released 25 years ago
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: Pocket full of tunes
angles.copy: Remember the original iPod? 25 years since it was unveiled, it changed how we listened to music forever. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the iconic British spy's film franchise.

angles.name: Shaken, not stirred
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! Which 007 film theme gets your heart racing, and who is your definitive Bond?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles co-founder John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering a legend
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the unparalleled talent and enduring legacy of John Lennon. What's your favourite Lennon song?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: British comedy icon and Monty Python star John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Ministry of Silly Walks
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, what's his most unforgettable role for you?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: A blank canvas of sound
angles.copy: It's the anniversary of The Beatles' sprawling 'White Album' release. Which unexpected gem or classic track from this diverse record is your favourite?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away on November 24, 1991.

angles.name: The show must go on
angles.copy: Remembering the irreplaceable Freddie Mercury on the anniversary of his passing. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential album 'Rubber Soul' on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: A turning point in sound
angles.copy: On this day in 1965, The Beatles gave us 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that saw them push musical boundaries. What's your go-to track?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's passing
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the tragic death of John Lennon, who was fatally shot on December 8, 1980.

angles.name: Gone but never forgotten
angles.copy: On this poignant anniversary, we remember John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to inspire generations.
